title: Second continuous Galois cohomology of separable-closure units
statement: For a field K, let Ks be its separable closure and G=Aut_K(Ks) with the Krull topology. Give M=Additive((Ks)^×) the discrete topology and the natural G action. Define H²_G(Ks^×) as the degree-two homology of the continuous homogeneous G-invariant cochain complex of this action. This is Mathlib continuousCohomology 2 of the indicated TopRep over the discrete integers.
